# Self-checkout terminals will not accept refunds at launch

## Decision Question

Should the self-checkout lanes be able to return money to a customer on day one of the pilot?

## Decision Outcome

Proposed, not agreed. Ruben Ortiz wants refunds disabled at self-checkout until the desk has a month of pilot data. Ellie Kwan's position is that it ships enabled and disabling it is a config change someone has to ask for, which is a different conversation than whether it should be on.

## Alternatives Considered

- Enable refunds at self-checkout under the same $500 threshold as a staffed register, which nobody argued against on the merits and nobody sponsored either.
- Enable them only at the two pilot stores while the desk is watching, which Ruben read as the same thing with a slower name.

## Approved By

Nobody yet. Written down as proposed so the pilot go/no-go has something to point at.

## Context

The question surfaced at the 2026-03-31 readiness session, where it became clear the two people talking were not disagreeing about policy so much as about which way the default already pointed.
